response.sql:
WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg_value
  FROM station_avgs
)
SELECT 
  sa.observstation,
  sa.station_avg,
  sa.station_avg - oa.overall_avg_value AS difference
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_avg_value
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" means excluding NULL bandusagepct values from each station's average calculation, not excluding entire stations that have any NULL values.

alternatives.interpretation: Only include stations where all telescopes have non-NULL bandusagepct values. This interpretation would exclude any station with any missing bandwidth usage data.
alternatives.sql:
WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
  HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(bandusagepct)
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg_value
  FROM station_avgs
)
SELECT 
  sa.observstation,
  sa.station_avg,
  sa.station_avg - oa.overall_avg_value AS difference
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_avg_value
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
